messages.content: 約翰是一位律師，正在最高法院的一個案件中，案件編號為「12345」。他需要從這個案件中取得「被告」的詳細信息。工作結束後，他計劃幫助兒子完成作業。他的兒子正在學習三角形，需要計算底邊為10單位、高度為5單位的三角形的面積。單位是「平方公尺」。之後，約翰還要回去工作，從高等法院的另一個案件中取得「判決」的詳細信息，案件編號為「67890」。你能幫助約翰完成這些任務嗎？

function.name: calculate_triangle_area
function.description: Calculate the area of a triangle given its base and height. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

unit.description: The unit of measure (defaults to 'units' if not specified)

function.name: get_case_info
function.description: Retrieve case details using a specific case docket number and court location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

docket.description: Docket number for the specific court case.

court.description: Court in which the case was heard.

info_type.description: Specify the information type needed for the case. i.e., victim, accused, verdict etc.

message.reasoning:
We need to parse user request: John needs from case "12345" at Supreme Court? Actually says "最高法院的一個案件", so court likely "Supreme Court". He wants "被告" info. Then he wants help with son's homework: compute area of triangle with base=10 units, height=5 units, unit="平方公尺". Then after that, he wants to retrieve "判決" info from another case "67890" at higher court? It says "高等法院的另一個案件". So court likely "High Court".

Thus we need to call get_case_info twice: first with docket "12345", court maybe "Supreme Court" or "最高法院"? The function expects court as string; we can pass "Supreme Court" or "最高法院". Probably use English names: "Supreme Court" and "High Court". Provide info_type accordingly: "accused" for 被告, "verdict" for 判決.

Also call calculate_triangle_area with base=10, height=5, unit="平方公尺".

We should produce calls to functions via JSON. According to guidelines, we should output only function calls, no other text. But we have multiple calls. We can chain them: first call get_case_info for accused, then calculate_triangle_area, then get_case_info for verdict. Each call separate JSON object. Let's do that.
